title.narrative: African Research Initiative for Scientific Excellence - Pilot Programme (ARISE-PP)

description.narrative: The ARISE-PP, through a Pan-African call for proposals, is to identify, select and support the very best African researchers, based on ambitious project proposals demonstrating feasibility and ground-breaking nature of their research.
